headline: Ramayana Day 20: ₹17.50 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana closed Day 20 on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 at ₹17.50 Cr India nett and ₹20.50 Cr India gross, +37.8% from Day 19's ₹12.70 Cr. That day played on 15,817 shows at 28.1% occupancy. This is the closed day on the desk, not a live estimate.
body:
Through Day 21 the desk has Ramayana at ₹992.0 Cr India nett, ₹1,173.5 Cr India gross, ₹582.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,755.5 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹982.45 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹4.10 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹2.70 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The desk figure remains ₹992.0 Cr India nett and ₹1,755.5 Cr worldwide. No producer-certified total is included.
